sources.marks: The cape has a large white print reading 'PEDRO NAVAJAS Barbería Guadalajara' at y 0.62-0.89; the crop (top edge to y 0.6) cuts it out completely. Keep the crop's bottom edge at or above 0.6 so the crown at the top of the print stays out. There is a partial emblem on a blue shirt at the far left (x < 0.1, around 0s), also outside the crop. The client's face is recognisable throughout, and the barber's face is too during 1-7s; both are Mixkit stock models covered by the Mixkit licence. During 7-11.5s the barber's head has left the frame and only the client and the clipper remain.

sources.marks: From 2.5s the cape shows a large white 'PEDRO NAVAJAS Barbería Guadalajara' logo at x 0.30-0.75, y 0.36-0.56. Either use only 0.0-2.3s, or after that crush the white print to black with a soft-edged mask (white line art on a black cape, so it disappears easily). The barber's shirt has a small chest emblem at about x 0.75, y 0.15 from about 3s on; blur it or leave it unreadable. Faces of the client and the barber are recognisable (Mixkit stock models).
